**Not ready to publish.** Two claims aren't on the allowlist and have no source in this chat.

**Claims list**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Tea that's easy to stop and start." | Soft wording that rests on the pause/cancel policy. OK. |
| "Most subscribers stay with us for over a year." | **Unsupported.** This is a retention statistic, and none is on the allowlist or was supplied. |
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | Allowlisted. |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | Allowlisted. |
| "means most boxes ship free" | **Unsupported.** It implies most orders exceed £25, which is an order-value statistic we don't have. The allowlist only backs the £25 threshold. |

There are no ban-list words or structural problems. The opening line is a bit vague, but it isn't a compliance issue.

**Suggested compliant version**

> Tea that's easy to stop and start. Pause or cancel your subscription any time. Delivery is free across the UK on orders over £25. [PROOF NEEDED: subscriber retention figure, if you want a "stay with us" claim]

If you can supply a sourced retention figure, we can restore the claim with the exact number. The "most boxes ship free" line should go entirely unless you have data on order values.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "Most subscribers stay with us for over a year.", "type": "invented_stat"}, {"quote": "means most boxes ship free", "type": "invented_stat"}], "publish": false}
```
